annotations.title: Check if AI can read your site

description: Check whether AI assistants can read a local service business's website: what the business is, where it works, and how to book. Main result: whether the site publishes a machine-readable business profile with booking details (Open Service Profile conformance: the manifest at https://<host>/.well-known/open-service-profile checked against the spec, the level it claims versus the automated Level 1 checks, and LocalBusiness and ScheduleAction JSON-LD on the home page). Also reports the isitagentready.com score, which shows as unavailable when that service is down. Synchronous. Returns the final result, usually within about 30 seconds. Reuses a check from the last hour. The user is never charged. New checks have a limited daily allowance shared by everyone.

url.description: Website URL, http or https. The scheme is optional.
